svg.title: Figure 2a. Full Matmul banks and cyclic optical shuffle
svg.desc: Two banks of four representative Full Matmul units surround a cyclic optical shuffle. Each unit has a local purple recirculating loop for weights a_m. An amber shared reference b_m feeds all units. Full Matmul includes the temporal accumulation. Only the blue data field x passes through the shuffle. Each row depicts the comb carried by one fiber. Varying stem heights depict illustrative comb-line intensities. The comb lines are laid out by group, with dotted separators marking the groups directly above their tiles. Each group contains interleaved frequencies. The four displayed lines in a group have indices r, r+4, r+8 and r+12. Letters and colors identify the source Full Matmul: A, B, C and D correspond to input fibers 0, 1, 2 and 3. Group r from input j goes to output (j+r) modulo 4 and retains its frequency indices. Each colored line connects the lower edge of an input tile to the matching output tile. The arrows indicate the direction of group transfer. Crossings pass over one another. The output strip carries the same illustrative intensities for each routed group. Each output fiber receives one group from each source. In the eight-fiber, 64-line design, group r contains indices r+8q for q=0 through 7. The figure uses an abstract optical shuffle. A cyclic AWGR is the reference implementation and a configured wavelength-selective cross-connect is an alternative.
